senses.en: relating to prediction, especially of the outcome of an illness

example.en: Age is a prognostic factor in recovery.
example.zh: 年龄是影响康复的预后因素。

senses.en: a sign of something to come

example.en: Dark clouds were a prognostic of rain.
example.zh: 乌云是下雨的预兆。

senses.en: unfair favoring of one person or side over others

example.en: The teacher was accused of partiality toward certain students.
example.zh: 这位老师被指偏袒某些学生。

senses.en: a strong liking for something

example.en: She has a partiality for dark chocolate.
example.zh: 她偏爱黑巧克力。

senses.en: the amount a ship can carry; a very large quantity

example.en: Shiploads of grain were delivered to the harbor.
example.zh: 整船整船的谷物被运抵港口。

senses.en: any of the numbers 0 to 9, or a figure in a number

example.en: Please write your four-digit PIN code.
example.zh: 请写下你的四位数字密码。

senses.en: a finger or toe

example.en: The injury affected one of his digits.
example.zh: 伤势累及了他的一根手指。

senses.en: a person who conducts opinion surveys of the public
senses.zh: 民意调查员；民调机构人员

example.en: Pollsters interviewed thousands of voters before the election.
example.zh: 民意调查员在选举前走访了数千名选民。

senses.en: the characteristic spirit or beliefs of a group, culture, or era

example.en: Hard work is part of the company's ethos.
example.zh: 努力工作是这家公司精神特质的一部分。

senses.en: the online world of computer networks and the Internet

example.en: Millions of people spend hours in cyberspace every day.
example.zh: 每天有数百万人在网络空间中度过数小时。

senses.en: the act or process of damaging something so badly that it no longer exists or works

example.en: The earthquake left a trail of destruction through the town.
example.zh: 地震在镇上留下了一片破坏的痕迹。

senses.en: the act of completely ruining something such as hopes, trust, or a career

example.en: The scandal led to the destruction of his political career.
example.zh: 这起丑闻导致他的政治生涯被毁。

senses.en: causing someone to feel upset, insulted, or disgusted

example.en: His comments were offensive to many people.
example.zh: 他的言论冒犯了许多人。

senses.en: used for or relating to attack rather than defense

example.en: The army prepared for an offensive operation.
example.zh: 军队准备进行一次进攻行动。

senses.en: a planned military attack

example.en: The army launched an offensive at dawn.
example.zh: 军队在黎明时发动了进攻。

senses.en: to draw liquid or air into the mouth by lowering the pressure inside it

example.en: The baby sucked milk from the bottle.
example.zh: 婴儿从奶瓶里吸奶。

senses.en: to pull something in by suction or as if by a vacuum

example.en: The vacuum cleaner sucks up dust.
example.zh: 吸尘器吸起灰尘。

senses.en: (informal, sometimes rude) to be very bad or unpleasant, or to be bad at an activity
senses.zh: 糟糕；很烂；不擅长（非正式，可能粗鲁）

example.en: This movie really sucks.
example.zh: 这部电影真的很烂。

senses.en: one of the hard pointed parts that grow on the head of some animals

example.en: The goat lowered its head and pointed its horns at us.
example.zh: 那只山羊低下头，用角对着我们。

senses.en: a device that makes a loud warning sound, especially on a vehicle

example.en: She sounded the horn to warn the cyclist.
example.zh: 她按响喇叭提醒骑自行车的人。

senses.en: a brass musical instrument with a long curved tube

example.en: He plays the horn in the school orchestra.
example.zh: 他在学校管弦乐队吹圆号。

senses.en: the act of putting something new or equivalent in place of something else

example.en: The replacement of damaged parts is part of routine maintenance.
example.zh: 更换损坏的部件是日常维护的一部分。

senses.en: a person or thing that takes the place of another

example.en: We need a replacement for the broken printer.
example.zh: 我们需要一台替代那台坏打印机的设备。

senses.en: the quality of being determined; firmness of purpose

example.en: Her determination helped her finish the marathon.
example.zh: 她的决心帮助她跑完了马拉松。

senses.en: the act of finding out or deciding something, often by research or calculation

example.en: The determination of the drug's composition took several weeks.
example.zh: 这种药物成分的测定花了好几周。

senses.en: to do something illegal or wrong

example.en: He committed a serious offence.
example.zh: 他犯了严重的违法行为。

senses.en: to give your time, effort, or loyalty to someone or something

example.en: She committed herself to the local project.
example.zh: 她投入了当地的项目。

senses.en: to write something down or learn it exactly

example.en: He committed the poem to memory.
example.zh: 他记住了那首诗。

senses.en: to stop working permanently, usually because of age

example.en: She retired from teaching after thirty years.
example.zh: 她执教三十年后退休了。

senses.en: to withdraw from a game, race, or competition

example.en: He retired from the match with an ankle injury.
example.zh: 他因脚踝受伤退出了比赛。

senses.en: to move away to a quieter or more private place

example.en: After dinner, the guests retired to the garden.
example.zh: 晚饭后，客人们退到了花园里。

senses.en: a fenced or walled area that surrounds something

example.en: The horses are kept in a large enclosure behind the barn.
example.zh: 马被圈养在谷仓后面的一大片围场里。

senses.en: something enclosed, such as a document sent with a letter

example.en: Please find the signed contract as an enclosure to this letter.
example.zh: 请查收随信附上的已签署合同。

senses.en: the act of enclosing something

example.en: The enclosure of the garden took only two days.
example.zh: 花园的圈围只花了两天时间。

senses.en: unable to walk properly because of an injured or disabled leg

example.en: The old horse went lame after the long journey.
example.zh: 那匹老马在长途跋涉后跛了。

senses.en: (informal) weak, unconvincing, or boring

example.en: That's such a lame excuse for missing class.
example.zh: 这个缺课的借口也太站不住脚了。

senses.en: to make a person or animal unable to walk properly

example.en: The accident lamed the racehorse.
example.zh: 事故使这匹赛马跛了。

senses.en: made up of parts that are all the same or of a similar kind

example.en: The mixture must be homogeneous before it is poured into the mold.
example.zh: 在倒入模具之前，这种混合物必须是均匀的。

senses.en: the desire to harm someone or see them suffer

example.en: He acted without malice, simply out of carelessness.
example.zh: 他并非出于恶意行事，只是粗心而已。

senses.en: (law) wrongful intention, or reckless disregard of likely harm
senses.zh: （法律）恶意；加害故意或明知危害而罔顾后果

example.en: The court had to decide whether malice was involved in the act.
example.zh: 法庭必须判断该行为是否出于恶意。

senses.en: a company or person that supplies goods or services

example.en: We switched to a cheaper supplier last year.
example.zh: 我们去年换成了一家更便宜的供应商。

senses.en: a public sale where items are sold to the highest bidder

example.en: The painting was sold at auction for a high price.
example.zh: 这幅画在拍卖会上以高价售出。

senses.en: to sell something at an auction

example.en: They decided to auction the old furniture.
example.zh: 他们决定拍卖旧家具。

senses.en: a person's sexual identity, orientation, or feelings

example.en: She felt comfortable talking openly about her sexuality.
example.zh: 她能坦然地谈论自己的性取向。

senses.en: sexual activity, desire, or the capacity for sexual feelings

example.en: Human sexuality is studied in many university courses.
example.zh: 人类性欲是许多大学课程的研究内容。

senses.en: in biology, the features or processes related to sexual reproduction

example.en: Sexuality in plants is more complex than scientists once thought.
example.zh: 植物的有性生殖比科学家过去认为的更为复杂。

senses.en: the people who regularly attend a particular church

example.en: The congregation sang hymns together every Sunday.
example.zh: 会众每个星期天一起唱赞美诗。

senses.en: a gathered group of people or things

example.en: A congregation of seabirds gathered on the cliff.
example.zh: 一群海鸟聚集在悬崖上。

senses.en: the way you hold your body when standing or sitting

example.en: Good posture helps prevent back pain.
example.zh: 良好的坐立姿势有助于预防背痛。

collocations: sit up straight to improve posture

senses.en: an attitude or position taken on an issue

example.en: The company adopted a defensive posture after the criticism.
example.zh: 受到批评后，该公司采取了防御性姿态。

senses.en: to strike poses or behave in an affected way to impress others

example.en: He kept posturing in front of the mirror.
example.zh: 他不停地对着镜子摆姿势。

senses.en: an open area surrounded by walls or buildings

example.en: The hotel rooms open onto a quiet courtyard.
example.zh: 旅馆的房间朝向一个安静的庭院。

senses.en: able to dissolve in a liquid such as water

example.en: Sugar is soluble in water.
example.zh: 糖可溶于水。

senses.en: able to be solved or explained

example.en: The problem turned out to be soluble.
example.zh: 这个问题原来是可以解决的。

senses.en: thick and sticky, flowing slowly

example.en: Honey is much more viscous than water.
example.zh: 蜂蜜比水黏稠得多。

senses.en: to wake up or wake someone up

example.en: She was wakened by the sound of thunder.
example.zh: 她被雷声吵醒了。

senses.en: a system for sending typed messages over telephone/telegraph lines; a message sent this way

example.en: She sent a telex to confirm the order.
example.zh: 她发电传确认订单。

senses.en: to send a message by telex

example.en: Please telex us your latest price list.
example.zh: 请电传告知贵方最新价目表。

senses.en: the postal abbreviation for Delaware, a US state
senses.zh: 特拉华州（美国州名）的邮政缩写

example.en: Her address lists Newark, DE as her hometown.
example.zh: 她的地址上写的家乡是特拉华州纽瓦克。

senses.en: the day before today

example.en: Yesterday was rainy, but today is sunny.
example.zh: 昨天下雨，但今天是晴天。

senses.en: on the day before today

example.en: I went to the library yesterday.
example.zh: 我昨天去了图书馆。

senses.en: the recent past

example.en: That style feels like yesterday's fashion.
example.zh: 那种风格就像昨日的时尚。

senses.en: a small cheap ornament or piece of jewelry

example.en: The stall was full of cheap trinkets for tourists.
example.zh: 摊位上摆满了卖给游客的廉价小饰品。

senses.en: according to usual or accepted practice; usually

example.en: Guests are customarily welcomed at the entrance.
example.zh: 按惯例客人在入口处受到欢迎。

senses.en: a man who rides horses, especially skillfully

example.en: An experienced horseman guided us along the mountain trail.
example.zh: 一位经验丰富的骑手带我们沿着山间小路前行。

senses.en: planned or expressed in a way that seems unnecessarily large or impressive

example.en: He made grandiose plans that no one believed he could carry out.
example.zh: 他制定了浮夸的计划，没人相信他能实现。

senses.en: a narrow raised platform models walk along at a fashion show

example.en: The new collection was shown on the catwalk in Paris.
example.zh: 新系列在巴黎的T台上展示。

senses.en: a narrow walkway high up, as above a stage or along a bridge

example.en: Stagehands walked along the catwalk above the stage to adjust the lights.
example.zh: 舞台工作人员沿着舞台上方的狭窄通道走动，调整灯光。

senses.en: great energy and enthusiasm

example.en: She tackled the new project with gusto.
example.zh: 她满怀热情地着手这个新项目。

senses.en: one of a pair of poles with footrests used for walking high above the ground

example.en: The children walked on stilts at the festival.
example.zh: 孩子们在节日上踩高跷行走。

senses.en: a post that supports a structure above the ground or water

example.en: The beach houses stand on tall stilts.
example.zh: 这些海滨房屋立在高的支柱上。

senses.en: to get something that someone sends or gives you

example.en: She received a letter from her old friend.
example.zh: 她收到了老朋友的来信。

senses.en: to be given or experience something such as treatment or attention

example.en: He received medical treatment after the accident.
example.zh: 事故后他接受了医疗救治。

senses.en: to greet or welcome a visitor formally

example.en: The mayor received the delegation at City Hall.
example.zh: 市长在市政厅接待了代表团。

senses.en: to pick up a signal or broadcast

example.en: The old radio can receive shortwave signals.
example.zh: 这台旧收音机能接收短波信号。

senses.en: to become involved in a situation in order to change or stop what is happening

example.en: The teacher intervened when the two students started arguing.
example.zh: 当两个学生开始争吵时，老师出面干预了。

senses.en: to happen or exist between two events or times

example.en: Ten years intervened between their first meeting and their marriage.
example.zh: 从初次相遇到结婚，中间隔了十年。

senses.en: a crash in which two or more objects hit each other

example.en: Two cars were involved in a collision on the highway.
example.zh: 两辆车在高速公路上相撞了。

senses.en: a strong disagreement or conflict between people or ideas

example.en: The new policy caused a collision between the two departments.
example.zh: 新政策引发了两个部门之间的冲突。

senses.en: limiting what people can do or what is allowed

example.en: The country has restrictive immigration laws.
example.zh: 这个国家有限制性的移民法律。

senses.en: honest and direct, even when the truth is uncomfortable

example.en: She gave a candid answer about her mistakes.
example.zh: 她坦率地回答了自己的错误。

senses.en: informal and natural, especially in photos taken without posing

example.en: The album is full of candid shots of the family.
example.zh: 相册里满是这个家庭抓拍的照片。

senses.en: soft, light and covered with or full of fine hair or down

example.en: The cat has soft fluffy fur.
example.zh: 这只猫长着柔软蓬松的毛。

senses.en: light and airy in texture, as food

example.en: The omelette came out light and fluffy.
example.zh: 这份煎蛋卷做得松软。

senses.en: based on or consisting of anecdotes rather than scientific evidence

example.en: The study's findings are anecdotal, so more research is needed.
example.zh: 这项研究的结论只是轶事性的，还需要更多研究。

senses.en: full of interesting short stories

example.en: She gave an anecdotal account of her years abroad.
example.zh: 她生动地讲述了自己在国外的趣闻轶事。

senses.en: to make something slightly wet

example.en: Light rain dampened the ground overnight.
example.zh: 小雨一夜之间打湿了地面。

senses.en: to make a feeling or activity less strong

example.en: The bad news dampened their enthusiasm for the project.
example.zh: 坏消息削弱了他们对这个项目的热情。

senses.en: a critical point in time, especially when a decision must be made

example.en: At this juncture, we must decide whether to continue the project.
example.zh: 在这个关键时刻，我们必须决定是否继续这个项目。

senses.en: friendly and without anger, especially about a disagreement

example.en: They ended their partnership on amicable terms.
example.zh: 他们以友好的方式结束了合作关系。

senses.en: to spill or overflow liquid, or make it spill

example.en: Water slopped over the edge of the bucket as he carried it.
example.zh: 他提水桶时水从桶边溅了出来。

senses.en: wet waste food, especially for feeding pigs

example.en: The farmer poured slop into the pigs' trough.
example.zh: 农夫把泔水倒进猪槽。

senses.en: muddy or messy liquid

example.en: The path was covered in thick slop after the rain.
example.zh: 雨后小路上满是厚厚的泥浆。

senses.en: very much; extremely (informal, often British)

example.en: I'm dreadfully sorry about the mix-up.
example.zh: 对这个失误我非常抱歉。

senses.en: in a way that causes fear or shock

example.en: The refugees were treated dreadfully during the journey.
example.zh: 难民们在旅途中受到了可怕的待遇。

senses.en: fading or disappearing quickly; lasting only a short time

example.en: The beauty of the sunset was evanescent, gone within minutes.
example.zh: 日落的美景转瞬即逝，几分钟内就消失了。

senses.en: a swollen vein in or near the anus

example.en: The doctor explained how to manage hemorrhoids with diet changes.
example.zh: 医生解释了如何通过调整饮食来应对痔疮。

senses.en: a chemical substance used for cleaning things, especially clothes and dishes

example.en: Add some detergent to the washing machine.
example.zh: 往洗衣机里加一些洗涤剂。

senses.en: not friendly or interested; distant in manner

example.en: He seemed aloof at the party, talking to no one.
example.zh: 他在聚会上显得很冷淡，谁也不理。

senses.en: in a distant or unfriendly way

example.en: She stood aloof from the argument.
example.zh: 她对这场争执置身事外。

senses.en: causing someone to lose hope or enthusiasm
senses.zh: 令人气馁的；使人泄气的

example.en: The test results were discouraging for the whole team.
example.zh: 测试结果让整个团队都很泄气。

senses.en: to kill all bacteria on something so it is clean and safe

example.en: Nurses sterilize the instruments before surgery.
example.zh: 护士在手术前对器械进行消毒。

senses.en: to make a person or animal unable to have babies

example.en: The clinic offers to sterilize stray cats.
example.zh: 该诊所为流浪猫提供绝育服务。

senses.en: activities done regularly for enjoyment in one's free time

example.en: Her hobbies include painting and playing the guitar.
example.zh: 她的爱好包括绘画和弹吉他。

senses.en: large wild cats that live in Africa and India; male lions have a mane

example.en: We saw a pride of lions resting in the shade.
example.zh: 我们看到一群狮子在阴凉处休息。

senses.en: famous or admired people who are much sought after

example.en: He was one of the lions of the literary world.
example.zh: 他是文学界的名人之一。

senses.en: not belonging to or trained for a profession; done as an amateur

example.en: The contest is open to nonprofessional photographers.
example.zh: 该比赛对非职业摄影师开放。
